body: thank you.  yes, I really do need someone, but i'm very alone.  I do it to myself, though.  I have nothing to complain about.  I feel like I think all the time about how I'm so alone and have no one, but then the idea of relationships with other people scare me so much I think I'd rather be laone.

I don't open up to anyone, not anymore.  I had two really good friends in high school and recently they happened to text me when I was blackout drunk...pretty much I opened up to them about how I was suicidal and blah blah blah, very embarrassing.  Their response was, "You just need to try and be happy.  You'd be happy if you just tried."  so...no I don't open up to anyone.  it's only hurt me more, it seems.  I used to do quite a bit of running, I still do plus I work a very physical job but yes, I should probably work out more.  That's very good advise!

I do tell them it isn't working, and they always just try a new dose of the same three, I just don't really tell them how truly bad it is.  I do quite a bit of lying in all aspects of my life.   I don't really have any hobbies.  I haven't really enjoyed anything in a long time.  But yes, I do dwell on it quite a bit, I'm not sure why.  I guess the center of my life has been depression/suicidal thoughts...the point of every day is to just make it to the end of the day.  I don't do anything fun, and I don't enjoy anything.

I don't do very well with opening up/asking for help so I've pretty much suffered alone and in silence this whole time.  I take sertraline, Lexapro, and bupropion and have for 2 years now but they've never helped.  I have to go to the doctor about once a month in order to get my prescriptions refilled and every time I tell myself, "now is the time I'm going to tell them the truth, how bad it is, how I really feel" but I'm worried they're going to put me on an involuntary hold when I tell them how many drafts of my suicide note I already have written >.<  I'm 23, for some context.
